title: Verify cancellation during EUR replay execution
changes: Record exact-request cancellation during a real interpreter replay as a bounded DBG2-15 validation increment.
validation: In a copied EUR DS-20 replay, the worker reported running at 10/102 frames before exact-ID cancellation; the same run reported interrupted at 21/102 and the control request returned cancelled. The paused parent state, frame and clock, source profile, protected inputs and session pins remained unchanged; session and display closed.
limitations: This validates cancellation in one Wine/interpreter case. A deadline while guest frames execute, complete assistant procedure and parity, native Windows and physical input remain unverified.
